author: Volker Simonis
html:
The stack size you set is a “virtual” size which gets committed (i.e. backed by physical memory) pagewise if you use it. In your toy example your thread stacks barely use more than a single page (plus the internal shadow pages – see https://pangin.pro/posts/stack-overflow-handling for the details).

You can use tools Like pmap to see the exact reserved (i.e. virtual) and committed (i.e. physical or RSS) memory consumption of each thread.
